patch_description: New approach: treat it as the Tammes/Best-packing problem in two phases. Phase 1: on the unit sphere, run annealed projected-gradient ascent on a log-sum-exp soft-minimum of pairwise distances (temperature geometrically cooled), which directly maximizes dmin with dmax≤2 guaranteed by the sphere projection. This uses many diverse structured+random restarts. Phase 2: take the top candidates, release them from the sphere and refine with L-BFGS on a smooth (dmin/dmax)² surrogate with increasing sharpness beta, allowing dmax to shrink below 2 — the true objective can then exceed the spherical bound. Finally an exact-score swap/rotation micro-polish targets the bottleneck pair. True non-smooth score is tracked throughout and the best configuration is returned.
